successCriteria.description: `LeaveService` class exists at `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts`, implements `ILeaveService`, and accepts `ILeaveRepository`, `IEmployeeService`, `IPolicyService`, `IBalanceService`, and `IAuditService` via constructor injection.
`createDraft(dto)` persists a new `LeaveRequest` with status `DRAFT` via `ILeaveRepository.create` and returns it. No business validations beyond field presence are applied.

`submitDraft(requestId, employeeId)` transitions a DRAFT to SUBMITTED only after passing all gates in order: (1) employee is ACTIVE via `IEmployeeService.isActive`, (2) no overlapping SUBMITTED/APPROVED requests via `ILeaveRepository.findOverlapping`, (3) minimum notice satisfied (unless emergency leave type), (4) sufficient balance via `IBalanceService.getAvailableDays`. On success, reserves days via `IBalanceService.reserveDays` and audits the transition via `IAuditService.log`.

`submitDraft` auto-approves when the policy's `requiresManagerApproval` is `false`: transitions directly to APPROVED with `approvedBy=null` and `approvedAt=null`, calls `IBalanceService.deductDays`, and audits the transition.

`approve(requestId, approverId, approverRole)` transitions SUBMITTED → APPROVED only when the approver is the employee's manager (via `IEmployeeService.getManagerId`) or has role `hr_admin`. Self-approval is rejected. On success, calls `IBalanceService.deductDays`, sets `approvedBy` and `approvedAt`, and audits the transition.

`reject(requestId, approverId, approverRole)` transitions SUBMITTED → REJECTED with the same authorization rules as approve. On success, calls `IBalanceService.releaseReservation` and audits the transition. REJECTED is terminal.

`cancel(requestId, employeeId)` transitions any non-terminal state (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED) to CANCELLED. If the prior state was SUBMITTED, calls `IBalanceService.releaseReservation`. Audits the transition. Does NOT restore usedDays for APPROVED requests.

A pure `countBusinessDays(startDate, endDate)` helper function exists in `leave.service.ts`, counting Monday–Friday inclusive of both dates, with no external dependencies (no holiday table). Used by `submitDraft` to compute the requested day count.
`getById(requestId)` and `getByEmployee(employeeId)` delegate to `ILeaveRepository.findById` and `ILeaveRepository.findByEmployee` respectively, with no additional business logic.

`src/modules/leave/index.ts` re-exports `ILeaveService`, `LeaveService`, `CreateLeaveRequestDto`, `UserRole`, and all five error classes (`InsufficientBalanceError`, `OverlappingRequestError`, `EmployeeNotActiveError`, `MinimumNoticeError`, `NotManagerError`) alongside the existing model and repository exports.

Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.service.test.ts` cover: all lifecycle transitions (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED, SUBMITTED→REJECTED, DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED→CANCELLED), auto-approval path, balance check rejection, overlap rejection, employee-not-active rejection, minimum-notice rejection, unauthorized-approver rejection, self-approval rejection, and the `countBusinessDays` helper with various date ranges.

constraints: The `LeaveService` implementation MUST NOT modify the existing `ILeaveService` interface, `CreateLeaveRequestDto`, `UserRole` type, or any of the five error classes — these are already defined and correct. The implementation must conform to the existing signatures exactly.
All database access MUST go through the injected repository interfaces (`ILeaveRepository`, `IBalanceRepository` via `IBalanceService`). No direct SQL or pool access in `LeaveService` — per GP-001.

Every state-changing operation (createDraft, submitDraft, approve, reject, cancel) MUST call `IAuditService.log` with the entity type `'LeaveRequest'`, the request ID, the action name, old/new status values, and the acting user ID — per GP-002.
outOfScope: HTTP controller, route definitions, and Fastify plugin registration — these belong to Phase 10.
Notification integration (`INotificationService`) — the `LeaveService` does not call notification methods. Notifications are triggered by the controller layer in Phase 10.

Cross-fiscal-year request splitting — the reconciled architecture mentions splitting consumed days proportionally across affected years, but this is not part of the current phase's business rules and is deferred.

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (APPROVED | REJECTED). Any non-terminal state (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED) → CANCELLED. REJECTED and CANCELLED are terminal — no further transitions allowed. A request in DRAFT status cannot be approved or rejected; only SUBMITTED requests can be approved or rejected.

No two LeaveRequests for the same employee may overlap in date ranges when both have status SUBMITTED or APPROVED. Overlap is defined as `existing.startDate <= new.endDate AND existing.endDate >= new.startDate`.
`approvedBy` and `approvedAt` MUST be set (non-null) when status transitions to APPROVED via explicit manager/HR approval. When auto-approved (`requiresManagerApproval=false`), both MUST remain null.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller identity (`employeeId`) must match the request's `employeeId`. Only the owning employee may submit their own draft.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `EmployeeNotActiveError` if employee is not ACTIVE. Throws `OverlappingRequestError` if an overlapping SUBMITTED/APPROVED request exists. Throws `MinimumNoticeError` if notice period is insufficient (unless emergency leave). Throws `InsufficientBalanceError` if available balance < requested days. Throws a generic error if the request is not in DRAFT status.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: `approverId` must match the employee's `managerId` OR `approverRole` must be `'hr_admin'`. `approverId` must not equal the request's `employeeId` (no self-approval).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `NotManagerError` if the approver is unauthorized. Throws a generic error if the request is not in SUBMITTED status.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Same authorization as `approve`: `approverId` must match the employee's `managerId` OR `approverRole` must be `'hr_admin'`. Self-rejection is forbidden.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws `NotManagerError` if the approver is unauthorized. Throws a generic error if the request is not in SUBMITTED status.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: `employeeId` must match the request's `employeeId`. Only the owning employee may cancel their own request.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws a generic error if the request is already in a terminal state (REJECTED or CANCELLED).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No authorization enforced at the service layer — these are pure read operations. Authorization (if any) is enforced at the controller/route layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns `null` or empty array when no results found; never throws for missing data.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `LeaveService` must call `IBalanceService.reserveDays`, `IBalanceService.deductDays`, and `IBalanceService.releaseReservation` with the exact signatures defined in `src/modules/balance/balance.service.interface.ts`. The reservation model (remainingDays decremented on reserve, usedDays incremented on deduct) is owned by BalanceService — LeaveService must not duplicate or bypass it.

`LeaveService` must call `IAuditService.log` with the parameter shape defined in `src/modules/audit/audit.service.interface.ts`: `{ entityType, entityId, action, oldValues, newValues, performedBy }`. The `entityType` must be `'LeaveRequest'`, `action` must reflect the operation name (e.g. `'submitDraft'`, `'approve'`, `'reject'`, `'cancel'`), `oldValues`/`newValues` must capture at minimum the status before and after.

`LeaveService` must use `IEmployeeService.isActive` and `IEmployeeService.getManagerId` as defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.service.interface.ts`. The `isActive` check requires both `employmentStatus === 'ACTIVE'` AND `terminationDate === null` — LeaveService must not reimplement this logic.

`LeaveService` must use the `LeaveRequest` interface exactly as defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts`. All state transitions must produce `LeaveRequest` objects conforming to this shape, with `status` values from `LeaveRequestStatus` and dates as `Date` objects.

`LeaveService` must use `ILeaveRepository.findOverlapping` with its exact signature `(employeeId, startDate, endDate, excludeId?)`. The overlap query in the repository already filters for SUBMITTED/APPROVED statuses — LeaveService must not add its own status filtering on top.

integrationPoints.why: Employee active gate on submit; manager lookup for approval authorization
Look up the LeavePolicy to check minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval, and leaveType (for emergency bypass)
Balance check on submit; reservation on submit; deduction on approve; release on reject/cancel
Audit every state transition per GP-002
